a series of new poly (glycidyl methacrylic acid) -based supramolecular poly cationic gene vectors were constructed by the self-assembly of multiple star poly (glycidic acid) -based polyethylene glycol (Ad-PGEAs) units with a PGED-CD backbone, which possessed a large number of flanking cyclodextrin species (CDs) and gadolinium ions.

a series of PGED-Gd3+@PGEA gene vectors with MRI function were readily constructed by assembly of PGED-CD3+-Gd3+ and PGEA units, which possessed multiple cyclodextrin species, and the PGED-GD3+@PGENA vectors had lower cytotoxicity than PEI, and exhibited significantly higher transfections than PEI or constituent units (PGD-CD-Gd3+ and Ad-PGEAs).
